cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You nodded at Friday. I'll tell the committee you've accepted me as project lead. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only agreed to the meeting date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. Everyone's following the timetable I set.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll attend, but I'm voting against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my finance watchdog. It's good to have the whole committee behind my leadership.
